description.value: Blind Tiger Vineyards is a family-owned, seasonal winery in Lake Country's Okanagan wine country offering wine tastings by appointment, a lively outdoor patio with lake views, and wood-fired pizza from Marno's. The vineyard leans into a spirit of inclusivity and good vibes, hosting regular live-music events, a drag show series, and welcoming pets and families alike. A Tiger Trunk Gift Shop sells branded merch and canned goods alongside a lineup of naturally grown, chemical-free estate wines.
